files.title: Audio or video URLs
files.description: Direct links to audio files (MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A, AAC, OGG, Opus, AMR, WMA, AIFF…) or videos (MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV…) to take the sound from.

bitrate.title: Bitrate (kbps)
bitrate.description: For MP3, M4A, AAC, OGG and Opus. 128 is fine for speech, 192–320 for music.

sampleRate.title: Sample rate (Hz)
sampleRate.description: Leave empty to keep the original. 16000 mono suits speech-to-text.

mono.title: Mono
mono.description: Mix down to one channel (half the size for speech).

normalize.title: Normalise loudness
normalize.description: EBU R128 loudness normalisation, so every file plays at the same volume.

loudness.title: Target loudness (LUFS)
loudness.description: -16 for podcasts and the web, -14 for streaming music, -23 for broadcast.

trimSilence.title: Trim leading and trailing silence
trimSilence.description: Removes silence at the very start and end of each file.

trimStart.title: Trim: start (seconds)
trimStart.description: Cut everything before this point. Leave empty to start at the beginning.

trimEnd.title: Trim: end (seconds)
trimEnd.description: Cut everything after this point. Leave empty to keep until the end.

fadeIn.title: Fade in (seconds)
fadeIn.description: Fade the volume in over this many seconds at the start.

fadeOut.title: Fade out (seconds)
fadeOut.description: Fade the volume out over this many seconds at the end.

keepMetadata.title: Keep tags (title, artist, cover)
keepMetadata.description: Copy title, artist, album and cover art into the output where the format supports it.

maxFileSizeMb.title: Max file size (MB)
maxFileSizeMb.description: Larger files are skipped with an error (not charged).
